objective: Speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

description: A master of stealth and deception you are not, however, all of that can and will change. You've obviously impressed those in charge with your meager skills, as the great Shenthul has asked for you by name.
Take the road north of here to Orgrimmar and speak with Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow.
completion: It is important that the Shattered Hand remains vigilant in the face of the changes Thrall wishes to bring about to the Horde. Our numbers alone will not be enough to overcome his rule - stealth and deception must be mastered.
